_comment: Industry config for licensed plumbing contractors.
rsa_guidance: Emphasize 24/7 emergency availability, licensed and insured, upfront pricing, and same-day service. Water damage risk from delays is a strong urgency lever. Credentials (licensed master plumber) build trust for larger jobs like repiping and water heater replacement.

city.heading: Why Plumbing Problems Need Fast Attention
city.intro: A slow drip or small leak can become thousands of dollars in water damage within hours. The sooner a licensed plumber diagnoses the issue, the lower the total cost and the less disruption to your home.
bullets: A slow leak under a sink can rot the cabinet floor and subfloor within days
A burst pipe can flood a room in minutes — water extraction and drying adds significant cost
Ignoring a drain backup can indicate a sewer line issue — caught early, it's a clean-out; ignored, it's excavation
Water heater failures often give warning signs weeks before a full failure — catching them saves the tank

cost.heading: What Does {service} Cost?
cost.intro: Plumbing costs vary by job complexity, access, and parts. We provide a written upfront quote before any work starts — no surprise invoices.
bullets: Access: jobs behind walls or under slabs cost more due to required demolition
Parts: we stock common parts on our trucks for same-day repair without a second trip
Water heaters: cost depends on unit type (tank vs tankless) and fuel source (gas vs electric)
Repiping: whole-home repiping is priced per linear foot — we measure and quote before starting
cost.callout: We provide a written upfront estimate before any work begins. No hidden fees, no trip charges.

company.heading: Why Choose Us?
company.intro: Licensed plumbers protect your home and your investment. Here's what sets us apart.
bullets: Licensed & Insured: fully licensed master plumber — license number available on request
Upfront Pricing: you know the cost before we start — no surprises on the invoice
Same-Day Service: most repairs handled the same day you call
Local & Family-Owned: we live in this community and stand behind our work

free-estimate.heading: What Happens During a Free Estimate?
free-estimate.intro: Our licensed plumbers diagnose the issue on-site and give you a written quote before any work starts. No obligation, no pressure.
bullets: We assess the full issue — not just the visible symptom
We check for related problems that could cause future failures
We give you honest repair-vs-replace guidance
You get a written quote — decide on your own timeline
free-estimate.callout: The estimate is completely free. Most repairs can be completed the same day.

insurance.heading: Does Insurance Cover Plumbing Repairs?
insurance.intro: Homeowner's insurance typically covers sudden and accidental water damage from plumbing failures (burst pipes, appliance leaks). The plumbing repair itself is usually the homeowner's responsibility — but the resulting water damage is often covered.
bullets: Water damage from burst pipes: typically covered under homeowner's policies
Sewer backup: covered if you have a sewer backup rider (we can document for your adjuster)
Gradual leaks: usually not covered — another reason to catch problems early
We provide documentation: photos, repair notes, and invoices for your insurance claim
insurance.callout: Ask us about documentation when you call — we provide what your adjuster needs.

removal.heading: How {service} Works
removal.intro: Our licensed plumbers follow a thorough process from diagnosis to final test.
bullets: On-site assessment — diagnose the root cause, not just the symptom
Written quote — itemized breakdown before any work starts
Repair or replacement — with quality parts, backed by our workmanship warranty
Final test — run water, check pressure, verify no leaks before we leave
Clean-up — we leave the work area clean
